auto_orient.description: Swap page dimensions to match image orientation if both are fixed.

border.description: Minimal border between image and page border (e.g., 2cm or 2cm:2.5cm).

colorspace.description: Force PIL colorspace (e.g., RGB, L, CMYK). Leave empty for auto-detection.

engine.description: PDF engine to use: internal, pikepdf, pdfrw.

first_frame_only.description: Only convert the first frame of multi-frame images.

fit_mode.description: Fit strategy: into, fill, exact, shrink, enlarge.

include_thumbnails.description: Include thumbnails as separate pages for multi-frame images.

input_files.description: List of input image file paths to convert.

keywords.description: List of keywords for PDF metadata.

nodate.description: Suppress timestamps in output for determinism.

output_file.description: Output PDF file path. Leave empty to use stdout.

page_size.description: Page size in format LxL (e.g., 210mmx297mm) or shorthand (e.g., A4, Letter^T).

pillow_limit_break.description: Disable Pillow's max pixel limit safety check.

producer.description: PDF metadata producer. Empty uses default.

viewer_fit_window.description: Resize viewer window to fit page size.

viewer_magnification.description: Zoom level: fit, fith, fitbh, or float value.

viewer_page_layout.description: Page layout: single, onecolumn, twocolumnright, twocolumnleft, twopageright, twopageleft.

viewer_panes.description: Side panes to show: outlines or thumbs.
